description: HOLE-ACTIVE-BODY and the owner rule on a framed wall, on a member that is NOT the last body: B2's walls without openings at 16 in o.c. (model.json of b2-walls-no-openings-16oc, materials included) plus a through Hole of diameter 1 in on the outer end face (X 144) of the FIRST stud (the front wall's flush end stud, X 142.5..144, the first body in tree order) at Y 1.75, Z 48 in, and an R0.25 in fillet on that stud's outer vertical edge (X 144, Y 0). The face and edge signatures are the ones /overlay hands a client; both picks resolve on the stud, which the hole and the fillet modify, while the active body when they are picked is the right wall's bottom plate (the 48th).
derivation: All in inches; x 25.4 = mm. The base is golden b2-walls-no-openings-16oc: volume 25 601.625 in^3, area 49 269 in^2, centroid (72, 60, 2753267/52016), mass 194628.065291478 g, centre of mass (72, 60, 619756467/12065456).

Hole: a through-all bore of radius 0.5 along -X through the stud's 1.5 thickness: volume pi x 0.25 x 1.5 = 0.375 pi = 1.1780972450961724, centroid (143.25, 1.75, 48). Area: + the bore wall 2 pi x 0.5 x 1.5 - the two discs 2 x 0.25 pi = +pi.

Fillet r = 0.25 along the full stud edge L = 92.625: volume (1 - pi/4) r^2 L = 1.2423434447069597; the removed spandrel's centroid sits r (5/6 - pi/4) / (1 - pi/4) = 0.0556 in from each face, at (144 - 0.0556, 0.0556, 47.8125). Area: L (pi r / 2 - 2 r) - 2 (1 - pi/4) r^2 (the two strips replaced by the quarter cylinder, and the corner off each end face). The bore (Y 1.25..2.25) clears the fillet's tangent line (Y 0.25) on the X 144 face.
centroid = (base x base centroid - each removal x its centroid) / volume = (1828.6280299277373, 1524.141981875149, 1344.4634310928982) mm.
Bounding box unchanged: X 0..144, Y 0..120, Z 0..97.125 in (the fillet is interior to the stud's box).
Topology: the bore adds 1 face and 3 edges (2 circles, 1 seam); the fillet replaces 1 edge with 1 face, 2 lines and 2 arcs (+1 face, +3 edges). 288 + 2 = 290 faces, 576 + 6 = 582 edges, 48 shells.
Mesh (linear_deflection 0.1): 1788 vertices / 1212 triangles, equal to the mesh of the independent build123d construction.

Independently cross-checked against a direct build123d construction (48 boxes typed from buildings.md; the first stud cut by a Cylinder and filleted with Solid.fillet on its X 144, Y 0 edge) in tests/test_cut_objects_to_cut.py, member for member.
tolerance_rationale: The base golden's (b2-walls-no-openings-16oc), absolute on a ~4e8 mm^3 part. Measured against the hand derivation: 1e-7 mm^3 on the volume, 0 on the area, <= 2e-12 mm on the centroid, 8e-11 g on the mass. The hole on the wrong member (the last plate) moves the centroid by metres.
roundtrip_tolerance_rationale: Measured 2026-10-21: the volume moves 7e-7 mm^3 across STEP (above ROUNDTRIP_TOL, 1e-7). Same cause as b2-walls-no-openings-16oc: the STEP round trip re-sums the 48 re-imported solids in another order (~1e-7 on a ~4e8 sum); volume and area only, centroid and bounds keep ROUNDTRIP_TOL.
